enchantment.nemos_enchantments.felling.d: Fells an entire tree by breaking one log.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.head_hunt: Killed mobs have a chance to drop their heads.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.magma_wal: Turns nearby lava into magma while you walk.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.reaper.de: Harvests multiple nearby crops at once.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.snow_walk: Allows you to walk over powder snow.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.soul_bind: Soul-bound items stay with you after death.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.soul_touc: Lets you pick up a monster spawner.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.wisdom.de: Blocks and mobs drop 50% more experience per level.
